title: MusicDrop v1.5.5 Available
changelog:
• Direct Device Media & Downloads Scan: Downloaded songs, downloaded videos, and all device media now seamlessly show in the Device tab with automatic scanning
• Interactive Storage Approval Flow: Clear, instant in-app storage & media permission prompt with one-tap approval so files appear immediately
• Unified Device Media Filtering: Filter pills for All Files, Songs, Downloads, and Videos with real-time media counts
• In-Tab Search & Rescan Button: Search device files instantly by name, artist, or folder, and refresh storage anytime
• Direct Video & Audio Playback: Play both local device music and local videos directly from the Device tab with video surface support
